LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 WORD CLASSES: PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are indefinite and reflexive pronouns?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly
2. use indefinite and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly
3. appreciate the role of indefinite and reflexive pronouns in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 WORD CLASSES: PRONOUNS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use indefinite and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of indefinite and reflexive pronouns in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are indefinite and reflexive pronouns?
2. Why do we use indefinite pronouns?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly
2. use indefinite and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly
3. appreciate the role of indefinite and reflexive pronouns in communication
